text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the birthday present. ...But 
why flower bulbs, of all things?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, the truth is... That isn't just an 
ordinary bulb!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You can tell your fortune by the color of 
the blooming flower! Pink boosts your luck 
in love, yellow boosts financial luck, and 
green improves your health luck, and so 
on...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Since you enjoy gambling, Nakayama-san, I 
thought you might like something like 
this.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Aaah............ It's not really like 
that, y'know. Well, not like you gotta 
force yourself to get it.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"No, wait! I've placed a proper 'bet' on 
this."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"This bulb will bloom into a red flower 
that brings victory luck"... That was the 
wish I held in my heart when picking out 
the one I gave you.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
With this, there won't be any fun in 
waiting to see what color it blooms into, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh............ I see. That certainly 
qualifies as a bona fide "gamble."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind humoring you, but... if 
anything other than red blooms, you know 
what happens, right?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, yes! Don't worry. ...Because the 
flower that blooms will definitely be red.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Guess I've got another flower to look 
after.
